name: Question 10
problem:
Use the definition of Laplace transforms to calculate $F(s)=L{f(t)},$ where $f(t)$ is given by 

$$
f(t)={\begin{aligned}{e}^{-3t},\, & t\le 1 \\ 4\, & t>1.\end{aligned}
$$

$\,F(s)=L{f(t)}=$ {{field-1}},
valid for {{field-2}}.
worked_solution:
We apply the definition of the Laplace transform:

$$
\begin{aligned}L{f(t)} & =F(s)={\int }_{0}^{\infty }f(t){e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t\end{aligned}
$$

So, for the piecewise function 

$$
f(t)={\begin{aligned}{e}^{-3t},\, & t\le 1 \\ 4\, & t>1\end{aligned}
$$

we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(s) & ={\int }_{0}^{\infty }f(t){e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{e}^{-3t}\cdot {e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }4\cdot {e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{e}^{-3t-st}\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }4\cdot {e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{e}^{-(3+s)t}\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }4{e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

Note that the improper integral diverges if $s\le 0.$

For $s>0,$ we calculate our Laplace transform as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}F(s) & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{e}^{-(3+s)t}\,\text{d}t+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }4{e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1}{-(3+s)}{[{e}^{-(3+s)t}]}_{0}^{1}+{\int }_{1}^{\infty }4{e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-(3+s)}}{3+s}+{lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{1}^{a}4{e}^{-st}\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-(3+s)}}{3+s}+{lim}_{a\to \infty }{(\frac{-4{e}^{-st}}{s})|}_{1}^{a} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-(3+s)}}{3+s}-\frac{4}{s}\cdot {lim}_{a\to \infty }({e}^{-as}-{e}^{-s}) \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-(3+s)}}{3+s}-\frac{4}{s}\cdot (0-{e}^{-s}) \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-(3+s)}}{3+s}+\frac{4{e}^{-s}}{s}\end{aligned}
$$

valid for $s>0.$

EXPLANATION

We apply the definition of the Laplace transform:

L{f(t)}=F(s)=∫0∞f(t)e−stdt

So, for the piecewise function f(t)={e−3t,t≤14t>1

we have F(s)=∫0∞f(t)e−stdt=∫01e−3t⋅e−stdt+∫1∞4⋅e−stdt=∫01e−3t−stdt+∫1∞4⋅e−stdt=∫01e−(3+s)tdt+∫1∞4e−stdt.

Note that the improper integral diverges if s≤0.

For s>0, we calculate our Laplace transform as follows:

F(s)=∫01e−(3+s)tdt+∫1∞4e−stdt=1−(3+s)[e−(3+s)t]01+∫1∞4e−stdt=1−e−(3+s)3+s+lima→∞∫1a4e−stdt=1−e−(3+s)3+s+lima→∞(−4e−sts)|1a=1−e−(3+s)3+s−4s⋅lima→∞(e−as−e−s)=1−e−(3+s)3+s−4s⋅(0−e−s)=1−e−(3+s)3+s+4e−ss valid for s>0.
